Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting heating oil, propane, and natural gas used to heat qualifying residences from the retail sales and use tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting heating oil, propane, and natural gasused to heat qualifying residences from the retail sales and use tax;adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofheating oil, propane or natural gas used to heat a qualifyingresidence. (2) For purposes of this section, the following definitions apply: (a) "Qualifying residence" means a residence for which an exemptionhas been granted under RCW 84.36.381. (b) "Heating oil" means any petroleum product used for spaceheating in oilfired furnaces, heaters, and boilers, including stoveoil, diesel fuel, or kerosene. "Heating oil" does not includepetroleum products used as fuels in motor vehicles, marine vessels,trains, buses, aircraft, or any offhighway equipment not used for p. 1 SB 6558space heating, or for industrial processing or the generation ofelectrical energy.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to theuse of heating oil, propane, or natural gas used to heat a qualifyingresidence. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
